claims.claimText: The Mill at Ward Cove publishes a complimentary shuttle to Berth IV in downtown Ketchikan, an approximately 20-minute drive each way, and asks visitors with appointments to allow at least 30 minutes to reach downtown.
claims.authorityName: The Mill at Ward Cove official schedules
claims.limitationsNote: The displayed ship schedule is for 2026. Shuttle departure cutoffs vary by ship and date; the published drive time excludes queues, walking and embarkation. Recheck the applicable season and call before promising a tour fit.
